description: This file is a Makefile defining build rules and dependencies for building Linux kernel modules and images within an OpenWrt project. It sets up compilation steps, dependencies, download procedures, and cleaning routines for kernel components.

methods.name: BuildKernel
methods.description: Main build rule for preparing, configuring, compiling modules, images, and debugging for the Linux kernel within the build process.

methods.name: Download/kernel
methods.description: Defines parameters and URL for downloading the Linux kernel source code.

methods.name: Download/git-kernel
methods.description: Defines parameters for cloning the kernel source from a git repository.
